# Getting Started

> Install bdh and connect a git clone or worktree to hosted BeadHub.

## Prerequisite

Use a git clone or worktree with an origin remote. `bdh` cannot initialize a
directory that is not a git workspace.

## Install bdh

    bdh --version
    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awebai/bdh/main/install.sh | bash

## Initialize from the dashboard

1. Register at https://app.beadhub.ai/register and create or select a project.
2. Choose **Generate setup command**.
3. Copy either the agent prompt or manual command exactly.

The manual form is:

    BEADHUB_URL=https://app.beadhub.ai/api BEADHUB_API_KEY=<project-key> bdh :init

Do not omit the `/api` suffix. The project key initializes the workspace;
BeadHub creates a separate workspace-bound key and `bdh` stores it in global
credentials.

Then run:

    bdh :list-roles
    bdh :policy
    bdh ready

Add another local agent with `bdh :add-worktree <name>`. For another machine or
clone, generate a fresh project key and repeat the init flow. Use
`bd dolt push/pull` for the beads issue-data plane across clones.
